source: CMS Timely and Effective Care National CSV
issue: National file contains aggregate measure rows and no hospital identifier
decision: Use only as a period-level national reference; do not rank hospitals
notes: OP-18c 257 minutes minus OP-18b 162 minutes equals 95 minutes for 2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30

issue: National OP-18b carries codes 25 and 26; OP-18c carries code 25
decision: Retain footnotes and document differing VHA/DoD inclusion
notes: Footnote 25 indicates VHA data included; footnote 26 indicates DoD data included

decision: Ingest separately by release and preserve release metadata
notes: Do not assume current dataset contains full quarterly history

issue: Sample counts and suppressed or small-cell values
decision: Retain Sample values and footnotes; do not rank suppressed records
notes: CMS documentation describes sampled eligible-patient reporting and notes confidence intervals can use sample size; a procedure for the gap between two hospital medians remains to be validated

decision: Maintain explicit dated crosswalk; do not auto-collapse identities
notes: Open for a full dated CCN crosswalk. The annual HCA Houston audit shows CCN 450097 as BAYSHORE MEDICAL CENTER in 2018 and HCA HOUSTON HEALTHCARE SOUTHEAST later; CCN 450775 shifts from KINGWOOD MEDICAL CENTER to HCA HOUSTON HEALTHCARE KINGWOOD. Southeast (450097) and West (450644) remain distinct IDs/names in the archived rows; see results/hca_houston_ccn_name_audit.csv.

decision: Use actual effective/operational date from primary source
notes: Hand-verified state table required

source: CMS Provider Data Catalog hospital archives
decision: Download yearly archives and extract Timely and Effective Care Hospital rows for OP-18a/b/c/d
notes: 31 snapshots with 145833 hospital-snapshot rows; periods begin in 2017; raw panel is reproducible and ignored by Git

issue: Certified hospital beds and psychiatric-unit beds
decision: Join hospital records to OP-18 by six-digit CCN and report as current contextual covariates
notes: Matched both fields to 100 percent of the 3023 hospitals in the latest-period driver model; source date is later than the September 2025 outcome

decision: Aggregate designated and high-needs geographic designations by county FIPS and join to hospital county
notes: Valid county FIPS for all 3023 driver-model hospitals; no matching geographic designation record is coded No; facility and population HPSAs excluded; county indicator is not hospital-specific workforce availability

issue: Quarterly rolling and calendar-year windows overlap and one 2020 window is six months
decision: Keep release date separate from measure period; deduplicate same period for summary and only compare like-duration periods
notes: No causal trend interpretation; snapshot-level summaries are not independent

source: CMS Timely and Effective Care definitions
issue: OP-18c transfer exclusion and OP-18b comparator population
decision: Describe both as discharged visits and distinguish psychiatric from nonpsychiatric/nontransfer; exclude admitted-patient boarding claim
notes: CMS topic page says both measures exclude transferred visits; OP-18b also excludes psychiatric/mental-health patients

decision: Use latest archive release that contains OP-18 rather than assuming every archive updates every dataset
notes: 2026-09-30 archive did not include Timely and Effective Care; latest OP-18 archive is 2026-08-13

source: CMS Hospital General Information and USDA ERS RUCC 2023
issue: Latest-period hospital characteristics and county rurality
decision: Join by CCN and state plus normalized county name; never backcast current ownership/type; leave ambiguous county-equivalent name matches unmatched
notes: Latest common OP-18 period ends 2025-09-30; current covariates retrieved 2026-10-20; RUCC county-name match 97.5% among complete-gap hospitals

decision: Use hospital type ownership emergency service and metro status with state fixed effects and state-clustered CR1 covariance; treat as exploratory association only
notes: 3023 hospitals; no acuity adjustment or validated median-difference interval; normal approximations are reported

decision: Define peer group as hospital type by RUCC metro/nonmetro before examining gap; suppress peer summaries for groups below 20 hospitals
notes: Group summaries are descriptive comparisons and not quality scores or rankings

decision: Record CMS final adoption of Emergency Care Access and Timeliness eCQM and removal timing for Median Time for Discharged ED Patients
notes: Voluntary eCQM reporting in CY2027 and mandatory in CY2028; old measure removal begins CY2028 reporting

issue: Approved SPA vs operational service launch
decision: Keep outcome analysis gated until first qualifying coverage and operating dates are reconciled
notes: CMS reports 20 states and DC with approved SPAs by 2024-09-12; this does not by itself establish statewide service availability

decision: Use CMS SPA effective dates as an exploratory intention-to-implement treatment; keep operational service start separate and unknown unless supported by state primary source
notes: 22 CMS SPA records; statewide operational coverage not verified for most states

decision: Use first fully covered annual period; omit transition period; hospital-level within-unit gap changes; state-cluster bootstrap
notes: Event time 0 pools 3 cohort cells and 4-state early cohort; only 3 post-event times supported; exploratory only

source: CMS Timely and Effective Care hospital OP-18 latest period
issue: Flag positive OP-18c minus OP-18b gaps above 1440 minutes across selected annual windows
decision: Apply the 24-hour flag to each selected annual hospital-period, retain values in primary models, and report a separate p99 winsorized driver sensitivity
notes: 2018 and 2020-2025 latest annual snapshots: 21 hospital-period flags across 12 CCNs; all meet the 11-case minimum. Eleven flagged periods are in 3 HCA Houston CCNs (West 450644, Southeast 450097, Clear Lake 450617). The latest-year two are Crescent Lancaster 670090 (6710 min) and HCA Houston West 450644 (2904 min). The p99 driver sensitivity caps 31 of 3023 latest-period values at 602.34 min; see results/hospital_gap_outliers_over_24h.csv and results/hca_houston_facility_annual_audit.csv.
